title: SM-ACC-004A: immutable, tenant-scoped account hierarchy with summary-posting exclusion
authority: Current owner instruction 2026-10-29: ممتاز نكمل؛ previous owner continuation and qualified merge permissions in governance project profile. This is one bounded slice of issue #25.
scope: Add optional parent account and postability to existing account chart without breaking legacy flat posting; same-type group parents, immutability of structural attributes, SQL and service protection against summary posting; tests and ADR.
out_of_scope: Accounting periods, closing, opening balances, invoices, POS, external integrations, payments, UI redesign, fiscal or production changes.
task: Create bounded account-group support: existing accounts default postable root; new nonpostable group can have same-type children; validate tenancy, parent state and structural immutability; enforce exclusion from journals even against direct database writes. Preserve reversal and journal replay.
validation: GitHub governance packet validation; exact-source Foundation CI including Alembic PostgreSQL upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade and backend tests; Accounting Web CI and Governance CI; isolated diff/same-session review. Local Postgres and device tests NOT RUN.
stop_conditions: Source mismatch, unauthorized mutation, unsupported Alembic migration, failed exact-source CI, account/journal financial regression, data loss or unclear business policy.
success_criteria: Legacy flat accounts post unchanged, summary grouping works, type/tenant/leaf parent violations refused, group journal lines cannot be persisted, posted journals and replay/reversal remain immutable, role checks unchanged, all CI pass.
